The planned single contracts/v1 artifact and all-consumer root audit address real duplication. Inventory/change/missing/extra/pin/stale-root rejection and two-location checks are specified. The spec explicitly adapts those consumers and release assertions for one packed SDK with actual included owned code/declarations, separate Node/browser entry points, neutral root and isolated tarball consumers. Private dev-signer, smartcard, unpublished dependency references and credentials are forbidden in that artifact. Registry publication is not performed by the rehearsal.

Retaining that oracle and real adapters without claiming a second normative production engine is appropriate. Host policy/approval routing remains distinct from physical device approval; S03/K01/QP01/Q02 and other device gates retain their responsibilities.

Fixed private taxonomy assertions must be individually replaced/retired; before/after per-case accounting is required, not only aggregate green counts.

Frozen closed evidence remains at original bytes/paths; complete result/artifact/acceptance/review/input/candidate/link closure is audited and pinned historical resolution is exposed through a derived index. Current P01 docs move to one named editable normative location with source equivalence; they do not inherit prior review after changes. Negative tests cover changed frozen bytes, missing closure, alias/escape/commit/blob/link/second-graph/stale-review attribution.
